spans.text: Ange, I'm going to start hacking after this, but I still need your help.
Signal jamming on the battlefield is very severe. I'll only be able to transmit successfully if you can maintain control on the surrounding radar comm stations.
So you'll be able to control the military units as long as we maintain control over the radar station, am I right?
Yes, but I might get disconnected from time to time as the current situation is...
So we might lose control over the military units every now and then, right? I'll prepare a solution for that ahead of time.
In any case, I'll take care of the radar stations. Just focus on taking down those big bruisers from the Military.
